result.summary: The page is largely functional, but horizontal carousel content is clipped at the right viewport edge, causing truncated restaurant/category text that looks broken. Found 2 notable layout issues and 1 minor styling concern.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card is cut off at the right edge and its title is truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol', making the restaurant name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding/inset to the horizontal list or show a clearer peek gradient so partially visible cards do not appear abruptly clipped; ensure titles remain readable or fully hidden.

issues.description: The category chip row shows a sliver of an additional chip at the far right edge after 'Healthy', creating an unfinished cropped look.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent end padding to the horizontally scrolling chip row or align the final visible chip so partial items are intentionally presented with edge fade.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is cut by the viewport above the tab bar with no clear continuation cue, which can look abruptly truncated on smaller screens.
issues.suggestion: Use a bottom fade, spacing, or snap behavior so partially visible content clearly indicates continued scrolling.
